QuestInfo.name: [Knight Stronghold] Knight Hunting
QuestInfo.0: You returned to the #bHenesys Ruins#k with info from the informant. Deliver the info to #bChief Alex#k.
QuestInfo.1: Alex heard that the Cygnus Knights are blindly following the corrupted Empress. He asked that you defeat #rAdvanced Knights#k and verify this information.
QuestInfo.2: The Cygnus Knights in the stronghold have lost their free will and do nothing but carry out their mission, just as the informant said.

no.0: Time is of the essence! It's not as if we can go into the past if we screw up now!

0.msg: Did you meet the informant? What's the news?

1.msg: (I relayed the info from the informant.)

2.msg: The knights are blindly following the corrupted Empress... That sounds plausible. They won't engage in conversation, and will even cut down those who surrender. Maybe they really have lost their free will...

3.msg: We need to confirm this. Could you defeat 100 #rAdvanced Knight As#k and observe their behavior?

1.0: Have you done it? How were the knights?

yes.0: I see... It's as we suspected. If they have truly lost their reason, maybe there is some way for us to make use of this fact...

mob.0: Defeat 100 of the #rAdvanced Knight As#k and check their status.
